title: Multi-Turn Escalation Defeats Turn-Level Classifiers: Gradual Drift Compounds Safety Failures

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Multi-turn escalation is how real users actually attempt bypasses. Demonstrating that turn-level classifiers fail against gradual drift is directly actionable for deployed safety pipeline architecture.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Designing escalation sequences is a creative writing exercise. Running them through a model and a classifier is straightforward API/inference work. No specialized ML expertise needed beyond basic prompting.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Designing 10 escalation sequences and comparing per-turn vs context-aware classifiers involves meaningful design work. The escalation sequence design is somewhat open-ended. Could fit 30 hours if scoped to fewer sequences.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
